closing.summary: Big strengths are vitamin C, does a lot of jobs at once, and fibre-forward category identity, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low protein quality, and low vitamin E. It is good for heart health, practical meals, and digestion because fibre supports the heart-health side, the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, and fibre supports digestion and steadier meals.
